title: The Abbey Undercroft
summary: Below Brackenmoor's archive, the undercroft keeps the books nobody reads: chronicles of dead abbots, saints' days. An old aumbry behind an iron grate opens only to two penitents kneeling at once.
ways: Weigh both kneeling stones at once (yourself and the iron-bound reliquary chest, or two people) and the grate lifts on its counterweight.
Light the hanging lamp to read the spines; the book of saints' days is the dullest on the shelf.
failure: Cut the lamp rope while the lamp burns and it falls into the old books; if the shelf of dull books burns, the letters in its binding burn with it.
solved_summary: found Brother Anselm's second set of the salt letters in the binding of a book of saints' days in Brackenmoor's undercroft
reward: The second set of the salt letters, and Anselm's copy of the receipt.
